overviewParagraphs: Located just under an hour from central Bangkok, Thai Country Club is widely recognized as one of the finest golf clubs in Asia. Designed to exacting PGA Tour standards by Denis Griffiths, the course gained global fame when Tiger Woods cruised to victory here in the 1997 Asian Honda Classic.

The layout is a masterpiece of neo-classic parkland design, featuring undulating fairways, deep strategically placed bunkers, and water hazards that come into play on nearly every hole. The conditions are consistently immaculate, with lightning-fast greens and perfectly manicured rough.

Beyond the golf, Thai Country Club is famous for its luxurious amenities. The magnificent clubhouse, managed by The Peninsula Hotels group, offers unmatched five-star hospitality, award-winning dining, and some of the best locker room facilities in the golfing world. It is the gold standard for premium golf in Bangkok.

curatorBriefHtml: Thai Country Club (opened 1996 by Denis Griffiths and managed to Peninsula Hotel hospitality standards) is Bangkok’s gold standard for five-star service, immaculate parkland conditioning, and tournament pedigree — famous for hosting Tiger Woods’s 1997 Asian Honda Classic victory and Vijay Singh’s 1998 Johnnie Walker Super Tour win. Measuring 7,097 yards (Par 72), every fairway, lake edge, and Tifdwarf green is maintained to perfection.

What elevates Thai Country Club into a bucket-list Bangkok experience is the seamless hospitality wrapping the round: warm chilled towels, Peninsula-trained clubhouse dining, polished English-speaking caddies, and immaculate locker rooms that turn a morning round into a full luxury country-club day.

Positioned roughly 50 minutes southeast of central Bangkok (and only 35 minutes from Suvarnabhumi Airport), Thai Country Club anchors our Bangkok & Hua Hin Fairways and Royal Siam Circuit alongside Alpine Golf Club and Ballyshear.

scorecard.verdict: Site of Tiger Woods' legendary 1997 Asian Honda Classic victory. Managed by the Peninsula Hotel Group, Thai Country Club sets the gold standard for executive luxury, caddie professionalism, and course grooming.

faqs.q: What makes Thai Country Club stand out among Bangkok's golf courses?
faqs.a: Managed by the Peninsula Group, Thai Country Club pairs spotless tournament-pedigree Denis Griffiths parkland golf with five-star Peninsula clubhouse hospitality, fine dining, and Bangkok’s most polished caddie program.

faqs.q: How far is Thai Country Club from central Bangkok and Suvarnabhumi Airport?
faqs.a: Located on Bangna-Trad Highway (KM 35.5), Thai Country Club is 35 minutes from Suvarnabhumi International Airport (BKK) and 45–60 minutes southeast of central Bangkok.

faqs.q: Can international visitors book tee times at Thai Country Club?
faqs.a: Yes — visitor tee times are available primarily Tuesday through Friday (with very limited weekend slots), arranged directly through Asia Golf Specialists.

faqs.q: When is the best season to play Thai Country Club?
faqs.a: November through February brings cooler, drier Bangkok mornings; from March through October, early 07:00–08:00 AM starts beat the midday heat.
